step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture represents a centralized security incident response and remediation pipeline on AWS. Security events from AWS native services (GuardDuty, Inspector) and third-party tools (Antivirus, HIDS) are forwarded to AWS Security Hub to centralize security findings into a standardized format. Once gathered, findings trigger CloudWatch Events, which kick off AWS Step Functions to execute remediation workflows using Lambda libraries. Step Functions then handles downstream notifications and ticketing across Slack, ITSM, and PagerDuty.

nodes.name: GUARD DUTY
nodes.notes: Analyzes AWS logs to detect suspicious activity.

nodes.name: INSPECTOR

nodes.name: ANTIVIRUS
nodes.notes: Third-party antivirus solution sending threat events.

nodes.name: HIDS
nodes.notes: Host-based Intrusion Detection System analyzing OS logs on EC2 instances.

nodes.name: SECURITY HUB
nodes.notes: Aggregates and centralizes all security events in a single standardized format.

nodes.name: CLOUDWATCH
nodes.notes: Captures Security Hub events as CloudWatch Events to act as an event bus.

nodes.name: STEP FUNCTION
nodes.notes: Orchestrates automated remediation workflows using Lambda libraries.

nodes.name: SLACK
nodes.notes: Sends notifications to a dedicated Slack channel for key security events.

nodes.name: ITSM
nodes.notes: Creates and manages ITSM tickets, automatically closing them if resolved.

nodes.name: PAGER DUTY
nodes.notes: Triggers alerts to call on-duty security analysts for High/Critical incidents.
